## Summary

<!-- What does this change and why? Link related issues. -->

## Type

- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `feat` — new feature
- [ ] `fix(data)` / `feat(data)` — holiday data correction / new year or calendar
- [ ] `docs` / `test` / `refactor` / `chore` / `ci`
- [ ] Breaking change

## Data changes (if any)

- [ ] Source: <!-- link to the official notice / circular -->
- [ ] Dataset `version` and `lastUpdated` bumped
- [ ] Moon-sighting-dependent entries marked `tentative`; nothing estimated in an `official` dataset
- [ ] Verification tests added or updated (weekdays, section totals, Bangla dates)

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run release:check` passes
- [ ] Tests cover the change
- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (it becomes the changelog entry)
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior or API changed
